avis.titre: Sad Experience for a Great Product
avis.texte: I've used this product for more than 10 years and the way it arrived to me this time gave me pause. Dirty bottle. Cap broken. Oozed cleanser dried up into a nice goo all the way around it. One sample product tossed haphazardly into the shipping box to accompany it. Back in the day, Fresh was a beautiful brand. Whatever you ordered came wrapped in matching tissue paper. I'm sure this is cost prohibitive - and probably always was. But, this was sooo far on the other end of the spectrum. Sure, I'll use my soy face cleanser. It will work as beautifully as it always has. But, the experience of receiving it was really disappointing and made me wonder where else corners were being cut and standards were being left behind.

A long-time favorite. I used this in Sub-Saharan Africa when my face was just weary. It lifts one's spirits as it soothes the skin. I use it now here at home when my skin is dry or sun-damaged. It is a special treat to carry this on long overseas flights for that bit of refreshment a person needs after sleeping sitting upright!

I've been using this product for years, and love it because it's especially kind to my reactive skin. The large pump is a great value; with two washes daily, it lasts almost six months. I bring the smaller tubes with me on vacation. No discernible fragrance--perfect for me. .
Not good for sensitive skin. Don't love the texture and smell either.

Burned my skin when I used the product and left me with redness. It's been a struggle with the return process as well. Customer service sent me a return label addressed to me instead of the company, after multiple calls to them I have to answer a verbal survey to actually receive the return label. I definitely won't place another order with fresh ever again.

avis.titre: Great for tattoos, wounds, and open eyes.
avis.texte: I originally bought this cleanser as a travel cleanser because my original Cetaphil doesn't come in a travel size. I absolutely adore it! It's very gentle on the face, especially the eye area. The biggest reason I bought Cetaphil was because it's a gentle cleanser that I can open my eyes in before washing it off. This cleanser is just the same and better! I use a mirror in the shower to wash my face, and after applying it to my face and eyes, I'm able to open my eyes with it still on without any burning or stinging sensation. I also use this to clean healing tattoos. My boyfriend and I got some tattoos done, and at the time we were in a hotel. This was the only cleanser I had on hand. It's amazing for healing tattoos. We had used this to wash off the ointment and a little blood that was on our tattoos in the shower, and it doesn't sting! This was under 12 hours of having our tattoos done. The artist was a bit heavy-handed on one of his larger pieces, and when I asked him if it was burning while I was washing it, he said no. Because it's so gentle on healing wounds and doesn't sting my eyes while they are open, this has become my absolute favorite. I'm so happy I chose this cleanser before my road trip. It smells fresh and removes skin tints from my skin. I don't wear much makeup, but it does remove the skin tints and concealer that I use. Overall 11/10! A pearl-sized amount goes a long way.
One my favorite cleansers. Very gentle. Doesn't dry out my skin.
